newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish C/A deficit at $3.3 bln in Jan-Nov 1996.
newsitem.headline: Turkish C/A deficit at $3.3 bln in Jan-Nov 1996.

text.p: Turkey's current account gave a deficit of $3.3 billion in January-November 1996, up from $886 million deficit in the same 1995 period, the central bank said.
It said the deficit including Turkey's unregistered earnings from suitcase trade stood at $561 in January-November.
The foreign trade deficit soared to $16.38 billion in the same period, from $11.44 billion in January-November 1995.
Turkey's current account deficit was $2.34 billion in 1995, after a $2.63 billion surplus in the previous year.
The release of current account data for 1996 was delayed due to technical problems in the calculation of foreign trade data caused by Turkey's customs Union with the European Union.
